description: `prose share` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli run share --help`, and the Action says the link is public and `cli org invite` gives one person access; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `share` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli run share --help`? `cli run share RUN_ID` mints a public, unrevocable 24-hour link to a run's artifacts; `cli org invite` gives one person access. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: `cli run share` makes a public, unrevocable 24-hour link; `cli org invite` gives one person access. Use `cli run share RUN_ID --preview`; `prose cli run share --help` shows its arguments.
